subfiles.about: Inquiry from the YMCA to the Secretary of State requesting guidance on U.S. policy regarding potential Japanese athletic participation in the 1948 London Olympic Games.
subfiles.from: H. T. Friermood, Senior Secretary, Health and Physical Education, National Council of the Young Men's Christian Associations
subfiles.summary: Friermood asks Marshall for State's policy on Japan at the 1948 Olympics.
subfiles.title: Letter from H. T. Friermood (YMCA) to Secretary of State George C. Marshall on Japanese participation in the 1948 Olympic Games
subfiles.to: George C. Marshall, Secretary of State

subfiles.about: State Department response stating that Far Eastern Commission deliberations on foreign travel may prevent Japanese participation in the 1948 Olympics, despite U.S. support for cultural ties.
subfiles.from: Frank A. Schuler, Jr., Chief, Japanese-Korean Branch, Division of Occupied Areas, Department of State
subfiles.summary: Schuler says Japanese travel is pending before the FEC and unlikely to be settled in time.
